en: A black and white postcard image shows a Baroque Marian column (plague column) in a European town square. The monument features a tall column topped with statuary of the Holy Trinity and gilded rays. At the base of the column there are additional religious statues. Surrounding the monument are cobbled streets, a decorative old building with steep gables and a cross on top, and a public square with pedestrians and a fountain. The architectural style of the buildings and column, as well as the language of the small amount of legible text, suggest a Central European city.
